note: Measured baselines for the PR gate (EVAL.md section 4). A row is claimed by bench + model + provider + prompt_version; `bun scripts/agent-eval.ts --baseline` fails the run when it drops more than one question below `passed`, hits the turn cap at all, or falls below `recall`. Never move a row in the same PR as the change it measures. avg_turns is 1 on every claude-code row because that provider owns its own loop: one qwry turn covers the whole conversation, so turns compare only within a provider (EVAL.md section 6). Every row is transcribed from the run artifact of the same name under eval/results/, `date` included: it is the harness's own `config.date`, so a row can be recomputed from its artifact and nothing else. That night's runs were spawned by a shell on UTC and so read 2026-09-04, one day behind the maintainer's local clock at the time (2026-09-05, 02:1x IST).
